android.desc:
Take complete control of your recurring expenses with Dues — the ultimate offline subscription tracker and recurring bill tracker designed to help you save money and organize your finances.

Never be surprised by unexpected charges or forgotten renewals again. Whether you need an intuitive subscription payment tracker, timely notification alerts, or an accurate breakdown of your monthly subscription costs, Dues keeps everything organized in one clean, distraction-free dashboard.

100% OFFLINE SUBSCRIPTION TRACKER & PRIVATE
Your financial privacy is our top priority. Dues is a completely offline subscription tracker with zero tracking, no cloud telemetry, and no account creation required. All your subscription records, renewal dates, and payment history remain securely stored on your device.

SMART RENEWAL & RECURRING PAYMENT REMINDER
- Subscription Renewal Reminder: Receive punctual notifications before your payment methods are debited.
- Recurring Payment Reminder: Customize reminder times and days in advance to suit your personal schedule.
- Reliable Alarm Delivery: Exact alarm scheduling ensures your renewal alerts trigger reliably, even after device reboots.
- Multiple Alert Slots: Set up to 3 separate reminder alerts per subscription with Dues Plus.

ACCURATE EXPENSE TRACKING & BUDGET INSIGHTS
- Subscription Expense Tracker: Gain clear visibility into your overall commitments and cash flow.
- Monthly Subscription Costs: Monitor combined monthly, annual, and weekly costs at a glance.
- Multi-Currency Support: Full formatting for 20+ major global currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, PKR, INR, CAD, etc.).
- Flexible Billing Frequencies: Effortlessly manage weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and yearly billing cycles.

EFFORTLESS SUBSCRIPTION ORGANIZER
- Clean Category System: Organize streaming, software, gaming, gym, utilities, and lifestyle services.
- Status Controls: Mark subscriptions as Active, Paused, or Cancelled without losing historical records.
- Safe Data Backup & Export: Export your subscription records anytime to CSV or JSON formats.
- Minimalist Dark & Light Design: Pure typography-driven interface with smooth animations and zero clutter.

DUES PLUS (Optional Upgrade)
Track unlimited active subscriptions and activate up to 3 custom reminder slots per service with a single yearly upgrade.

Stop wasting money on forgotten bills. Download Dues today — your private subscription tracker, recurring bill manager, and
